purpose: Freeze the specification chapter 8 inventory as exactly thirty-eight mutually referential JSON Schema documents with canonical instance identity, seven independent HDS state axes, evidence-origin separation, fail-closed reference integrity, Owner approval boundaries, and completion-state separation, without entering Typed Causal IR execution, trajectory normalization, corpus processing, or any promotion gate.

X.coordinate: Schema and static HDS record layer after PH-D02A canonical representation and before PH-D02C Typed Causal IR, interpreter, verifier ABI, Golden freeze, or corpus processing
inputs: PH-D02A canonical JSON, ID, digest, ZIP, NPZ, and trajectory digest contract
HDS distillation specification chapter 8 thirty-eight-schema inventory
HDS rev3.1a state-machine and evidence definitions
PH-D02B roadmap gates DG-00, DG-01, DG-02, and DG-14
synthetic valid and invalid schema-instance bundles
X.change_scope: PH-D02B schema contract, thirty-eight schema documents, pure offline registry and structural/reference validator, synthetic fixtures, conformance report, tests, phase evidence, and isolated distillation documentation only.

R.risk: A missing schema, ambiguous ID namespace, dangling or wrong-type reference, merged HDS state axis, inferred content mislabeled as observation or derivation, automatic single-choice commit, initially active RuleAtom, live approval, or conflated completion state would let later causal and promotion stages manufacture stronger claims than their evidence or authority permits.
R.required_response: Fail closed on schema inventory or filename drift, unknown schema or field, absent version or digest, invalid content-derived identifier, duplicate ID, dangling reference, reference-type mismatch, evidence-origin mismatch, semantic interpretation inside DeterministicDerivation, inferred evidence inside RawObservation, illegal state value, state-axis substitution, forced single selection under MULTI_CAUSAL or SUSPEND, initially ACTIVE or PROMOTED RuleAtom, ApprovalRecord authority drift, and completion-state implication.
R.claim_boundary: PH_D02B_SCHEMA_SET_PASS may establish only schema inventory, structural constraints, reference integrity, evidence/HDS/approval state separation, and synthetic conformance. It does not establish executable Causal IR, trajectory normalization, exact-fit causal support, Rule promotion, corpus processing, structure-bundle approval, Bridge readiness, AGI capability, or official readiness.

Mc.mechanism: A content-bound schema contract maps each of the thirty-eight authority names to exactly one repository-relative schema path, instance version, identity field, digest namespace, allowed references, evidence origin, state-axis use, and semantic constraints. A dependency-free registry verifies schema-document shape and inventory, validates the supported fail-closed JSON Schema subset, indexes bundle IDs, resolves typed references, and applies cross-record HDS, evidence, approval, RuleAtom, and completion invariants.
Mc.owner_authority: 大平鉄兵 remains the sole Rule, promotion, bundle, locked-final, official, and submission decision authority.
Mc.rollback: Revert PH-D02B-owned commits only; preserve PH-D01A/B source and environment artifacts, PH-D02A contract and vectors, all source bytes, external archives, pre-existing P22/CV worktree changes, and prior phase evidence.
